title: cli gc_run passes dummy ArticleMeta; retention policy always evaluates age=0
description: transit/cli/ops.rs cmd_gc_run() creates ArticleMeta with group='unknown', size_bytes=0, age_days=0 for every article. A policy with max_age_days=30 evaluates 0 <= 30 and pins everything. GC never removes articles. pinned_cids table lacks metadata needed to evaluate policies; schema fix required.
